$comment: Proposed candidate concepts that appear MISSING from the icon set, for use as a creation/benchmark exercise. Each candidate is checked against existing names for literal and semantic overlap. These are PROPOSALS ONLY. No SVG is generated here, and no candidate is approved. 'semantic_overlap' lists EXISTING icons that are near in meaning; every file named in a semantic_overlap list was confirmed to exist in the pinned source. Absence of the proposed NAME does not prove the CONCEPT is visually absent, so each selected candidate retains a semantic-confirmation review requirement. The pinned source/Git inventory is 601 SVG files; candidate name absence was checked against those 601 names.

figma_applicability.note: The 'missing concept' claims below were checked ONLY for name absence and semantic overlap against the 601-file pinned RUNTIME inventory. After PR66 a user-authored Figma design guideline (UI Assets Library, file Eprjc6hw7QyMvvD01eGgGy, section node 482:12945 'Icons') was supplied, including a large Icon Set frame (node 5051:11598). Filename-absence results remain valid ONLY against the pinned runtime inventory; Figma CONCEPT presence is pending comparison and no automatic name mapping or visual equivalence is inferred. See figma-guideline-addendum.md.

candidate_reassessment.fullscreen: NOT established as missing: a Fullscreen component (5051:12335) is present in the Figma Icon Set. No automatic name mapping/visual equivalence inferred; human confirmation still required.
candidate_reassessment.clock-history: NOT established as missing: an Undo Clock component (5051:13421) is present in the Figma Icon Set, which may satisfy the history/clock concept. No automatic name mapping/visual equivalence inferred; human confirmation still required.
candidate_reassessment.remaining: All other proposed candidates remain PROPOSED, not approved missing. The 13 selected concepts stay proposed-but-not-approved pending Figma comparison.

methodology.name_absence: All proposed_name values were confirmed ABSENT from the 601-file inventory (no file of that name exists).
methodology.overlap_existence: All icons listed under semantic_overlap were confirmed to EXIST in the 601-file inventory.
methodology.visual_confirmation_required: Name absence is necessary but not sufficient: the concept may already be satisfied visually under a different name. Each selected candidate therefore carries review_required=true for a human semantic/visual confirmation before any creation.
methodology.selected_count: The 'candidates' array holds the selected 10-15 plausibly-missing DISTINCT concepts. Highly-redundant concepts that are almost certainly already satisfied are held OUT of the selected set in 'conditional_reserve' and are not proposed for creation unless a human confirms the redundancy is false.

candidates.rationale: copy.svg exists but there is no paste counterpart; clipboard paste is a common editing affordance.
candidates.overlap_note: Distinct action from copy; low semantic collision but shares a clipboard visual family.
candidates.review_note: All overlap files exist; confirm copy/postit do not already imply paste.

candidates.rationale: thumbnails.svg and layers.svg exist but there is no plain NxN grid layout icon used for view-switching.
candidates.overlap_note: Moderate overlap with thumbnails; differentiate as layout-toggle vs image-grid.
candidates.review_note: All overlap files exist; confirm thumbnails does not already serve the grid-view toggle.

candidates.rationale: bell.svg exists but no muted/disabled bell; the -crossed modifier convention (see trash-crossed) supports this.
candidates.overlap_note: Uses the established -crossed modifier; low collision. Confirm bell (alert) vs service-bell (concierge) base.
candidates.review_note: All overlap files exist; confirm no muted-bell state is already present.

candidates.rationale: loudspeaker.svg and mic.svg exist but there is no muted-audio glyph.
candidates.overlap_note: Low collision; follows the -crossed modifier. Decide loudspeaker vs a dedicated volume base.
candidates.review_note: All overlap files exist; confirm no muted-audio glyph is already present.

candidates.rationale: resize.svg, minimize.svg and focus.svg exist but a four-corner fullscreen-expand arrows glyph is a distinct common control.
candidates.overlap_note: Moderate overlap with resize/minimize; a decision is needed on whether resize already covers this.
candidates.review_note: All overlap files exist; confirm resize does not already serve fullscreen-expand.
candidates.figma_note: A Fullscreen component (node 5051:12335) is present in the Figma Icon Set (5051:11598). Filename absence remains valid only against the pinned runtime inventory; this candidate is NOT established as a missing concept against Figma. No automatic name mapping/visual equivalence inferred.

candidates.rationale: No paperclip/attachment glyph exists despite mail and message icons being present.
candidates.review_note: All overlap files exist; confirm linked is a chain-link rather than a paperclip.

candidates.rationale: wifi.svg exists but no offline/disabled wifi state.
candidates.review_note: All overlap files exist; confirm no offline-wifi state is already present.

candidates.rationale: undo.svg and many clock variants exist but no 'clock with counter-clockwise arrow' history glyph.
candidates.overlap_note: Moderate overlap with undo and arrow-circle--flip; differentiate history vs undo action.
candidates.review_note: All overlap files exist; confirm undo/arrow-circle--flip do not already read as history.
candidates.figma_note: An Undo Clock component (node 5051:13421) is present in the Figma Icon Set (5051:11598) and may satisfy the history/clock concept. Filename absence remains valid only against the pinned runtime inventory; this candidate is NOT established as a missing concept against Figma. No automatic name mapping/visual equivalence inferred.

candidates.rationale: shoppingcart.svg and shopping-bag.svg exist; a cart-with-plus add-to-cart affordance is a common commerce action and follows the object-plus pattern (cf. luggage-plus, seat-plus, user-plus).
candidates.overlap_note: Low collision; uses the established object-plus naming pattern.
candidates.review_note: All overlap files exist; confirm no add-to-cart variant is already present.

candidates.rationale: filter.svg and menu-filter.svg exist but no 'clear filters' state.
candidates.overlap_note: Low collision; -crossed modifier. Confirm filter vs menu-filter base.
candidates.review_note: All overlap files exist; confirm no clear-filters state is already present.

candidates.rationale: Many calendar-* variants exist (checkin, checkout, day, week, month, year, price) but none for adding an event; follows object-plus pattern.
candidates.overlap_note: Low collision; fits the existing calendar-* family and object-plus pattern.
candidates.review_note: All overlap files exist; confirm no existing calendar variant already serves 'add event' before creating.

candidates.rationale: bookmark.svg and save.svg exist but no 'add bookmark' affordance; follows the object-plus pattern (cf. luggage-plus, user-plus, seat-plus).
candidates.overlap_note: Low collision; distinct add-to-collection action from a plain bookmark.
candidates.review_note: All overlap files exist; confirm 'bookmark' alone is not already used as the save-for-later affordance.

candidates.rationale: light-bulb.svg exists but no off/disabled state; the -crossed modifier (cf. trash-crossed) supports a negated variant.
candidates.overlap_note: Low collision; follows the established -crossed modifier.
candidates.review_note: All overlap files exist; confirm no off-state bulb is already present under another name.

conditional_reserve.rationale: An explicit 'box with outbound arrow' external-link glyph is a standard pattern.
conditional_reserve.reserve_reason: HIGH overlap: target-blank.svg and share-box.svg already exist and almost certainly satisfy this concept visually. Held out of the selected set; propose only if a human confirms target-blank does NOT cover external-link.

conditional_reserve.rationale: A static QR-code glyph without the scan framing.
conditional_reserve.reserve_reason: HIGH overlap: scan-code.svg exists and almost certainly satisfies this concept. Held out of the selected set; propose only if a human confirms scan-code does NOT cover a static QR glyph.

conditional_reserve.rationale: A scalloped verified badge may be a distinct brand concept.
conditional_reserve.reserve_reason: VERY HIGH overlap: badge-check.svg and cert-check.svg exist and almost certainly satisfy this concept. Held out of the selected set; propose only if a human confirms badge-check does NOT cover a verified badge.
